Also, sync mode omits the refresh token/params entirely.

judged_text: In sync mode `tokenInfo` is a raw fetch Response (not an axios result), so the unchanged check `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)` throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'error'). Zoho Bigin token refresh crashes with a 500 on every invocation when credential sync is enabled, taking down Bigin calendar operations for all synced users.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, the helper returns a raw `fetch(...)` Response. In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `tokenInfo` is obtained via `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` but the subsequent unchanged logic still treats it like an axios result: `if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`. A `Response` object has no `.data`, so `tokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and accessing `.error` will throw a `TypeError`, causing token refresh to fail (500) in sync mode.
